Case reference: 2014002814.CaseDesc: On December 17, 1983, Guy Turgeon was seen for the last time when he left his home in the Rosemont-La-Petite-Patrie District in Montreal, Quebec. He was despondent and suffered from mental health issues. Guy hasn’t been seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2010005899.CaseDesc: Mark Edmonson disappeared from his residence in Stoney Creek on October 3, 1999. Mark has not returned or contacted his family members since that time and both his family and Police are concerned for his well being. Mark is developmentally challenged. It is believed that Mark left home without taking any money or personal identification. Extensive police searches have failed to determine his whereabouts.

Pants: Blue, Jeans with hole in left knee

Case reference: 2014002267.CaseDesc: On April 11, 1992, Pawel Gazdzicki was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Pawel was despondent, suffered from mental health issues, and may have lost his memory. He had mentioned wanting to jump off of the Champlain Bridge.

Case reference: 2022001740.CaseDesc: On December 26, 2021, Gonzalo Rubi last spoke with his family and friends. Gonzalo’s bank card was last used on December 28, and his abandoned vehicle was subsequently located in a neighbourhood in London, Ontario, on January 15, 2022.

Tattoo: Right Hand, Cuba across the fingers

Case reference: 2012020074.CaseDesc: On August 22, 1988, Cathy Williams left her home in St. Andrews, Manitoba to submit an application for a position in Winnipeg. She had arranged to meet with a male acquaintance who was going to assist her with completing the application. During the late afternoon and early evening, Cathy and her friend visited two bars and subsequently went to a restaurant. Cathy left her friend at the restaurant to go to the residence of another male acquaintance who had invited her for a visit. She stated that she had to retrieve her purse from her friend's car and would be back in approximately half an hour. Cathy was reported missing by her mother on the morning of August 23, 1988. We have not had any further contact with Cathy.
